text:
jamie: Hey folks — quick PSA about tomorrow's all-new-hires orientation. A couple of people in APAC reported the invite shows up at the wrong local time for them. Can we double-check the calendar event timezone and the join link?

sara: Thanks for flagging. I just checked the event — it was created with 'UTC' as the timezone and some calendars are not converting properly.

leo: Ugh, that explains it. For folks in HK/SIN it's showing 01:00 instead of 09:00.

jamie: Yikes. Can someone update the event timezone to America/Los_Angeles (we're running it at 10am PT) and re-send the invite so clients re-sync?

anya: I can update — will set the event timezone to 'America/Los_Angeles' and add a note 'Time shown in your calendar may convert; please double-check local time'. Also I will attach the direct Zoom link in the description so if ICS flakes they can still join.

leo: Also — can we add the passcode in the description and a fallback link? Sometimes the native calendar client strips Zoom params. Example snippet I usually paste:

```
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=abcd
Passcode: Redwood2026
Fallback: https://zoom.us/w/1234567890
```

sara: Good call. Can you also re-upload the ICS to the #new-hires calendar and ping people to 'Add to calendar' rather than relying on the auto-accept behavior? Some corporate GSuite settings auto-accept which messes things up.

anya: Done. Updated tz to America/Los_Angeles, pasted Zoom link + passcode in description, re-attached new ICS. I've also added a short line for APAC: 'If you're seeing the wrong time, check your device calendar timezone settings or use the Zoom link at scheduled PT time.'

jamie: Amazing, thank you. Can someone confirm the recording will be available and where we'll post it? A couple of hires will be traveling and can't make the live slot.

devops-team: onboarding-bot: Recording will be uploaded to the /onboarding/recordings S3 bucket and a share link posted to this channel within 30m after the session ends. (This is an automated message from onboarding-bot.)

leo: Appreciate the automation — can we also request retention 90 days for these ones? New hires need time to watch.

devops-team: onboarding-bot: Noted. Default retention for new-hire orientation recordings set to 90 days.

anya: I'll also manually Pin the link in the event and drop a short note in the #new-hires thread after the session with the link + timestamped chapters.

jamie: One more tiny thing — for people who rely on calendar clients that ignore updated ICS, can you post the raw meeting start time in ISO in the event description, e.g. 2026-07-12T10:00:00-07:00 (PT)? That makes it explicit.

anya: Good idea. Added "Start (PT): 2026-07-12T10:00:00-07:00" into the description.

sara: Sending a short DM to the folks who RSVP'd 'Yes' with timezone reminders for APAC.

leo: Thanks team. I'll confirm with the UK hires too — their calendar should show 18:00 BST.

jamie: Perfect. If anyone still has calendar hiccups tomorrow, ping @onya or me and we'll drop a one-off invite. Thanks! :party_parrot:
